update.title: Matched Comfy Viewer thumbnail resolution to tile size
update.summary: Connected Comfy Viewer’s library-size presets to thumbnail generation and caching, letting dense grids load smaller previews while larger tiles retain more detail.

blocks.body:
## Load the resolution the gallery needs

The library’s four tile-size presets controlled the layout, but every card still loaded the same thumbnail resolution. I added the selected preset to each thumbnail request. Changing it refreshes the images already visible in the grid.

Compact layouts load smaller WebP previews, while larger tiles request additional detail.

## Cache each size independently

The thumbnail service generates separate cached files for each resolution across both local and remote image sources. Returning to a previously used size can reuse its cached preview, while cache cleanup preserves every valid size variant.

Tests cover preset fallback, distinct cache entries, output dimensions, cache statistics, and cleanup behavior.
